body_html:
A management suite built to anchor a private office. The Newland L-shaped layout pairs a rectangular island with a credenza, hutch, and pedestal — giving managers a full workstation with real surface area, integrated storage, and a clean, classic profile that holds up year after year. Reversible by design, it assembles for left- or right-hand applications to fit the room you have.

Features

  • L-shaped suite: rectangular island plus credenza with hutch and pedestal
  • 1" thick thermally fused laminate top with a 2 mm matching edge for daily-use durability
  • 2" square metal leg with leveling glides included
  • Reversible — assembles for left- or right-hand applications
  • Designed for quick and easy assembly
  • Available in all Newland laminate finishes to match your existing fit-out

Specifications

Overall footprint 66"W x 72"D x 29.6"H. Made in Canada by Global Furniture Group, ANSI/BIFMA tested and GREENGUARD Gold certified for low-emission indoor air quality. Backed by a 15-year warranty, with 5 years on moving and electrical parts.

Brant Business Interiors is a family-owned Canadian dealer (since 1964) and an OECM-eligible supplier — Ontario institutional buyers can purchase without an open tender. Request a Quote below or call 1-800-835-9565 for finish options, volume pricing, and lead times.
